title: Affine map realises coordinatewise inversion on the cube
statement:
Let $K$ be a field, let $\omega \in K$ be a nonzero element, and let $x \in \{1,\omega\}^n$, so that each coordinate $x_i$ equals either $1$ or $\omega$. Then for every coordinate $i$,
\[
  1 + \omega^{-1} - \omega^{-1} x_i = x_i^{-1}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: x lies in the cube {1,ω}^n (each coordinate is 1 or ω)
replaced:
If $\omega \neq 0$ and $x$ lies in $\{1,\omega\}^n$, then for every coordinate $i$,
\[
  1 + \omega^{-1} - \omega^{-1} x_i = x_i^{-1}.
\]
